description: Look up a recent sold price for one of your items, in your currency. Only for an item you own or have lent out: a wishlist, gift, borrowed or archived item returns an error and uses nothing. Draws on this month's market value checks and will not run once the allowance is used up. The check is counted after the lookup: a lookup that finds a value uses one check, and a lookup that finds no value is free, with charged false. From the 11th lookup with no value in one UTC day, a miss can use a check. The answer always carries charged, which says whether a check was used. When the same search was answered recently, that answer is returned with cached true and charged false, and no check is used. A currency other than USD is answered without spending a check, the same way the website does. When lookups are temporarily unavailable, or a lookup does not finish, no check is used. These checks are separate from the automatic value lookup an owned item gets when it is added, which never uses them. Does not change the saved value. Save a number you like with update_item.
name: get_market_value
title: Market value
